## About Me

I’m **Ankit Raj**, a Computer Science and Engineering undergraduate at **JIS University** (expected graduation: 2029). I’m building my foundation in software engineering, full-stack development, problem-solving, and practical AI applications through hands-on projects and continuous learning.

I enjoy turning ideas into useful software, learning how systems work end to end, and improving projects through iteration. My current priorities are strong programming fundamentals, data structures and algorithms, web development, databases, and applied AI.

- **Software Engineering:** Developing structured, maintainable applications with an emphasis on clean code, problem-solving, and engineering fundamentals.
- **AI / Machine Learning:** Exploring intelligent applications, predictive modeling, AI-assisted workflows, and practical machine learning.
- **Full-Stack Development:** Building end-to-end web applications, integrating APIs, managing application data, and delivering usable interfaces.
- **Product Engineering:** Turning ideas into working products through iterative development, debugging, testing, and deployment.
- **Problem Solving:** Strengthening Data Structures and Algorithms, complexity analysis, and programming fundamentals.
- **Continuous Learning:** Expanding technical depth through academic work, personal projects, and collaborative development.

### Open To

## Featured Projects

### AssessGen — Assessment Generation Platform

<details>
<summary><strong>Explore Project Details</strong></summary>

**Overview**

AssessGen is a web-based assessment generation tool designed to simplify the creation and preparation of structured placement-test question sets. It supports generating and importing JSON-based assessment data for use with a placement-test application.

**Engineering Highlights**

- Structured assessment data using JSON.
- Designed for reusable question sets and assessment workflows.
- Supports importing and preparing assessment content.
- Includes a configurable custom-time requirement for assessment sessions.
- Focuses on improving the efficiency of placement-test preparation.
- Includes deployment and iterative feature improvements.

| Attribute | Details |
|:---|:---|
| **Stack** | Web Technologies, JSON, Vercel |
| **Scale** | Assessment generation and placement-test workflows |
| **Performance** | Lightweight, browser-oriented application design |
| **Security** | Input validation and safe handling of imported data are important production considerations |
| **Impact** | Simplifies preparation and management of structured assessment content |
| **Repository** | [AssessGen on GitHub](https://github.com/rajankit3632/AssessGen) |

**Live Application:** [assess-gen.vercel.app](https://assess-gen.vercel.app/)

</details>

### SilentSpot — Workation Tourism Intelligence Platform

<details>
<summary><strong>Explore Project Details</strong></summary>

**Overview**

SilentSpot is a workation tourism intelligence platform designed to help users evaluate destinations for remote work by combining acoustic conditions, connectivity, facilities, and reliability into a structured Workation Score.

**Core Scoring Model**

\[
\text{Workation Score} =
0.35A + 0.35C + 0.15F + 0.15R
\]

Where:

- \(A\): Acoustic suitability
- \(C\): Connectivity
- \(F\): Facilities
- \(R\): Reliability

**Engineering Highlights**

- Multi-factor destination scoring.
- Random Forest-based temporal acoustic prediction.
- Data Reliability Score for communicating confidence in available information.
- Web Audio API-based sound-check functionality.
- Geoapify and OpenStreetMap-based geographic information.
- CARTO mapping integration.
- Tourism intelligence designed around remote-work suitability.

| Attribute | Details |
|:---|:---|
| **Stack** | Web Technologies, Python / Machine Learning concepts, Geoapify, OpenStreetMap, CARTO |
| **Scale** | Multi-factor destination evaluation and geographic intelligence |
| **Performance** | Weighted scoring and predictive modeling designed for practical destination comparisons |
| **Security** | API key protection, input validation, and responsible handling of location-related data are production priorities |
| **Impact** | Helps remote workers compare destinations using work-oriented environmental and infrastructure factors |
| **Repository** | [SilentSpot on GitHub](https://github.com/kazi716/silentspot) |

</details>
